judge.reason: The plan makes the lead the single writer of `abi/registry.rs` and the `mod.rs` wiring before spawning agents. It has `sys-rename` regenerate `docs/wire/` only after `sys-add` finishes, so the docs come from the merged sources, and the lead runs build/test plus a stale-name grep on the combined result rather than trusting separate agent checks. One minor gap: per-task oracles are thin, especially for `sys-add`, which only 'reports back' with no stated check, but owners and disjoint write scopes are explicit and no evidence is fabricated.
